content: Petɔlà anà Ywan u làbay a nsaŋ a kölàköl
Umpal bàkäl Petɔlà anà Ywan mukyäänà un'sɛŋ a baar, angaŋ, mfum a aleer a ndwà a Nzam anà Asadusi waa bàyi.
Ba bàkäl anki un'sak unsà an'lɔɔŋ aba akà un'sɛŋ anà mukun'kyään naa Yɛsu akyàwiyà kà an'lɔŋ ntɔn muswaŋ naa akü bàkyer asàwiyà.
Ba waa bakör, basi u bɔlokà tii taaŋtyà, ntɔn sisye làkäl aŋàkwo itaan.
Apan, bàmbɔɔn uboo a baar bàwem ndaa a Antööm bàkyer akyey ya. Abun abaal aŋàlàkwikilà bàkɔlà kà isii a nsaab tyeen.
Yàmɛnà naa taaŋtyà, amfum a un'sɛŋ, andweer anà alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn bàköŋ u Yɛlusàlɛm,
anà An, undweer a angaŋ, anà Kayifà anà Ywan anà Aleksandre anà baar banswà bàkäl u ywar a undweer a angaŋ.
Ba bàsi Antööm uboboo, waa bafuul naa: « Unsà ikɔ̈b nà itàkal kikɔb anà bɛ, bɛ làkyerà ndaa ayi? »
Apan Petɔlà kàkäl aŋàyɔl a Dweelà In'kyɛɛl, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: « Amfum a un'sɛŋ anà andweer,
isàkal naa ŋàbawà bàkifuulà ntɔn ubwaŋ kan'kyer bi ntɔn un'bɛy anà muyöb naa nde kan'kɔrà aben,

yubwaŋ naa bɛ anà un'sɛŋ a Isàlɛl wanswà làyöb naa unsà ikɔb a Yɛsu Klistɔ, un'nsi Nasàlɛr, mbuur akwà bɛ, bɛ lun'bɛɛrà u kulunsi anà kàtwey Nzam kà ukwà, waa mbuur wà kambar anà ngwal kusà a bɛ.
Mbuur awà wà nkɔŋ akwà làtön bɛ atööŋ anà kàbulà un'tswe a twɛrà a ndwà.
Lalan, ngweel a mɔ̈ɔ̈ yatɛy unsà mbuur asin, ntɔn uboo a baar u mɛɛn pà ikɔb a mbuur asin kyatɛy u mbwo a kya ban'kwo bi muwà mɔ̈ɔ̈. »
Baar a làbay a nsaŋ bàkäl mubem ntɔn bàmɛn ba uyɔl a Petɔlà anà Ywan anà muyöb naa ba bàkäl baar asànaa baar banswà, baar mpa bàtäŋ. Ba bàyöb naa ba bàyikalà ana Yɛsu.
Wɛɛ ba bàmɛnà sye mbuur kàkɔɔrà wà akyàmbar kusà a ba, ba undiir atɛn kàkäl anki.
Apan ba baswɛŋ mutoo u làbay a nsaŋ, waa bàbulà muyääm ba a ba, waa
bàtɛn naa: « Ininà bi kan'kwo mukyer anà baar bà? Ntɔn baar a Yɛlusàlɛm banswà bàkyàyöb ubwaŋàbwaŋ naa idiim aŋàmɛnà ba bàkyer. Bi ikwo anki mutɔn kya.
Wɛɛ ndaa ayi mukɔɔn apää uboo a un'sɛŋ wanswà, bi ikyer atsuŋ a ngwal ba mutɛn akà mbuur mwɛy kà ikɔb a akyɛy. »
Ba waa bàfabel, batsüŋ a ngwal mutɛn anà mulɔŋ kà ikɔb a Yɛsu.
Wɛɛ Petɔlà anà Ywan bafuur naa: « Làtsül bɛ ŋakwo, nkye yà balàbal u mii a Nzam, bi mulab ndaa abɛ anà mubɛy ndaa a Nzam?
Wɛɛ bi, bi iwɛy anki mukyään indiir kàmɛn bi anà kàwem bi. »
Baar a Làbay a nsaŋ bàläb mukasiinà a ngwal, waa bawɛy. Ba bàsàman anki mbwo mupà ba ntaaŋàmbar, ntɔn un'sɛŋ wanswà kàkäl musyäŋà Nzam ntɔn ndaa yàlyaaŋ.
Abun, mbuur awà kàkɔɔrà nkɔɔr impà kàkäl ayà mbul aŋàlyaŋ an'kwen an'nà.
Ngyamàkà a aŋàlàkwikilà
Ungö batsuuŋ ba, ba bàkyen akà atɔŋ aba bumwɛy, waa bakyään indiir byanswà bàtɛn amfum a angaŋ anà andweer aba.
Ungö muwem ndaa ayi, ba bàlaal unsà un'tüüb akà Nzam, waa bàtɛn naa: « Mwol, ngye, ngye kàkyer du, mɛɛn, ngyäl anà indiir byanswà abyà uboo mwo,
u mbwo a Dweelà In'kyɛɛl, ngye kàten u mun a nkaa abi David, un'syääl angye naa:

content.text: "Ntɔn nkye nsi yàbilà ya uboo a lingyoomà
anà in'sɛŋ myàkyer mya indiir ikɔ̈ɔ̈n ndöŋ?
Amfum a mɛɛn bàkyer ayööŋ munwan,
baar abye anà ikɔ̈b bàkyer aköŋ
ntɔn munwan a Mwol anà Klistɔ ande.
Ntɔn, yà ndandaa naa Ɛlɔdi anà Pɔns Pilatu bàköŋ u bul alà anà angyey anà in'sɛŋ a Isàlɛl ntɔn mutɔn un'syääl angye wà in'kyɛɛl, Yɛsu kàsi ngye an'kɔɔ,
ntɔn mukyer indiir byanswà kàbön ngye anà kàkwen ngye kusà.
Wɛɛ apanà, Mwol, kyɛɛŋ ubwaŋàbwaŋ ndaa aba yàmbe, apɛ atsüüŋ angye mbwo mukyään ndaa angye unsà uyɔl.
Abun, swaŋ ngwal angye ntɔn nkɔɔr, impà anà idiim byàmɛnà kà ikɔb a un'syääl inkyɛɛl angye Yɛsu. »
Umpal bàmay ba muyamà, ikal bàkäl ba muköŋ kyàkyer atɛɛr, ba banswà bàyöl a Dweelà In'kyɛɛl, waa bàkyään ndaa a Nzam anà uyɔl.

content: Aklistɔ bàkäbà indiir a ba, ba a ba
Apan, un'sɛŋ a baar bàsi làkwikilà bàkäl mpem anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ mwɛy, akà umwɛy kàkyey anki naa indiir ande ikäl byànde mpɛl, wɛɛ indiir byanswà byàkäl byà un'sɛŋ.
Abun, unsà ngwal mbɔɔn, Antööm bàtɛɛ imbäl a ngwiiyà a Mwol Yɛsu, kab a ngway a kölàköl làkäl udu a ba.
Kyakin, akà mbuur umwɛy uboo a ba kàkɔ̈ɔ̈n anki undiir. Ntɔn baar bàkäl anà an'ywaŋ itàkal ndwà, bàkyer ayälà, bweel bàyälà ba indiir abin bàkyer atwaalà,
anà bàpɛɛ akà Antööm, ungö waa bàkäbà mbuur mbuur u ngyal ande.
Apan, Yɔsefi, Antööm bun'pɛ ikɔb a Barnabas, iswaŋà naa « Mbuur afàpà un'kanà. » Nde kàkäl un'lɛvi, un'nsi Sipriyɔt,
nde kayälà ywaŋ ande, waa kàpɛ ngim ayin akà Antööm.
